fusions.name: Nudging Bump
fusions.desc: A slow shove of water that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wallowing Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls over in a slow heave of water that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 60% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Off
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbothered
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
